method_note: www.sec.gov returns 403 here and every FPI baseline carries an empty reaction history for that reason (n=0, not contaminated, just absent). Company date notices were read through StockTitan's per-ticker newswire mirror and newswire/IR copies found by WebSearch; where only the calendar row exists, the name is not confirmed.

names.why: Company press release (newswire copy) says Q3 2026 unaudited results on 23 Nov 2026 and a 7:00 AM ET call that Monday, so the print lands before the US open.
names.session_evidence: Call is set for 7:00 AM ET / 8:00 PM Beijing on Monday 23 Nov 2026, so the release comes before the open. VNET's Q3 2025 print followed the same pattern on 20 Nov 2025. https://finviz.com/news/418868/vnet-to-announce-unaudited-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-on-november-23-2026
where_to_look: The cause of the collapse: the stock is -42.8% over 20d and -28.6% over 5d, at its 52w low and -85% from its high (baseline tape). Find the trigger before anything else: a financing, a wholesale/hyperscale customer change, guidance withdrawal, a delisting or ownership event, or the sector.
Wholesale IDC customers: VNET's growth comes from a small number of hyperscale and AI customers. Look for capacity commitments, order cancellations and capex comments from those customers.
Financing trail: convertible notes, ABS/REIT issuance, and the company's net debt and capex funding. Look at recent 6-Ks and HKEX/ onshore REIT notices.
Option chain: the event-implied move is 5.38% against a 29.36% straddle and 133.6% ATM IV, so the market prices the overall volatility rather than the print itself.
already_in_the_wire: Date and call time (23 Nov, 7:00 AM ET)
Q3 2025 base: net revenue RMB2.58bn, +21.7% YoY (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vnet-reports-unaudited-third-quarter-2025-financial-results-302621456.html)
names.trades_on: unknown. The baseline has no reaction history (sec.gov 403) and I did not establish which line moved the last prints.
names.short_interest: Sources conflict. Equibles: ~13.9% of float, ~12.4 days to cover, as of 2026-10-02 (https://equibles.com/stocks/vnet/shortinterest). Chartmill: 101% of float, 9.23 days, 2026-10-15, which is likely a float-denominator error (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/VNET/ownership/short-interest). Treat it as high and crowded but unverified.

names.why: Freightos' own 15 Oct 2026 KPI release says Q3 2026 financial results come before the open on 23 Nov 2026, with an 8:30 a.m. ET call.
names.session_evidence: Results 'before markets open on November 23, 2026'; webcast and call at 8:30 a.m. ET. https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/freightos-reports-platform-kpis-for-third-quarter-exceeding-management-expectations-302909936.html
where_to_look: Solutions revenue, which is most of revenue and NOT covered by the pre-released KPIs. The company said it would update on Solutions with the results. Check WebCargo/Solutions customer and SaaS churn signals and Q2 2026 commentary on the Solutions trend.
Cash burn and runway against a ~$42m market cap at $0.80: look for ATM or shelf usage and Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance.
Freight market context for Q4 guidance: air and ocean rate indices (Freightos' own FBX/FAX) through November.
already_in_the_wire: Q3 2026 KPIs pre-released 15 Oct: GBV $437m (+30% YoY, a record), transactions 494k (+15%), 79 carriers, ~21.9k buyers (https://finviz.com/news/402839/freightos-reports-platform-kpis-for-third-quarter-exceeding-management-expectations)
names.trades_on: unknown. Platform KPIs are pre-released every quarter, so the transaction line is already public by print day. Which line moved the last prints was not established.
